# HR Industry Adoption & Implementation Considerations

| Consideration | Industry-level guidance |
| --- | --- |
| Workforce pattern | Multi-site, high-turnover, non-standard-hour and attendance-driven payroll operations usually have the strongest automation need. |
| Evaluation metrics | Compare HR processing hours, payroll error rate, onboarding time, attendance exceptions and reconciliation effort against a defined baseline. |
| Rule governance | Version regional wage, overtime, tax and social-insurance rules by effective date; record approvals before payroll closing. |
| Data readiness | Reconcile employee, organisation, position, site, contract and payroll masters before automation. |
| Rollout model | Start with one site or business unit, validate attendance and payroll reconciliation, then extend to more sites and countries. |
| Evidence quality | Separate audited outcomes, research estimates, supplier claims and internal measurements; do not generalise one customer result. |
